title.narrative: Aboud Connection Points Improvements Reinforcement of distribution and improvement of the Palestinian water systems to enable accommodation of the supplementary volumes supplied by Israel.

description.narrative: Aboud Connection Point (Contribution Agreement with AFD); Total Cost = Euro 23 Million (Euro 13 Million from EU and Euro 10 Million from AFD)The majority of the existing bulk water system for the Northwest Ramallah Villages is old, undersized and suffers from substantial water loss, which limits water supply from one geographical area within the system to another, with some villages receiving water once every seven to ten days. The Action will build a new/rehabilitated bulk water supply system.
